native_result.query: In which century did the Diversity in Pottery Form collapses and Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneuosly?
native_result.HypoA: Around 1800 BCE, Diversity in Pottery Form collapses, while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.
native_result.HypoB: Diversity in Pottery Form collapses and Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneously at BCE 1700 (the 17th century BCE), with a secondary inflection at BCE 1000 (the 10th century BCE) where Decoration rises further while Form stays collapsed.
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded the raw 37-bin century series PotteryForm and PotteryDecoration from time_series_data.csv (CE -4100..-500, 100-year bins). Computed 100-yr deltas. Applied thresholds with the active 37-bin sigma (Form std=0.98, Decoration std=0.86): collapse = drop <= -1.0 sigma with new floor <= -1.0 sustained for >= 4 consecutive bins; increase = rise >= +1.0 sigma with new plateau >= +0.7 sustained for >= 3 consecutive bins. Skipped BCE 4300/4200 leading bins (saturation floors with no baseline). Cross-checked against capital.csv ZKeform/Zkeverz (identical deltas at BCE 1700). Re-ran detection using the 3601-row _inter std as sensitivity test (same result). Identified BCE 1000 secondary inflection where Decoration fresh-steps +0.97 -> +1.53 while Form remains floored. No detrending applied (cols already Z-standardized). _inter columns used only as sanity check; saturation-floor clipping confirmed pushed apparent transition to ~CE -1750 so they were not primary.

sub_hypo.text: Around 1800 BCE, Diversity in Pottery Form collapses, while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.
sub_hypo.relations: Diversity in Pottery Form collapses while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.

gold_sub_hypo.full_hypo: Around 1800 BCE, Diversity in Pottery Form collapses, while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.

sub_hypo.text: Diversity in Pottery Form collapses while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneously at BCE 1700.
sub_hypo.context: BCE 1700 in the raw 37-bin, century-resolution series spanning CE -4100 to -500; already Z-standardized, with no detrending. BCE 4300/4200 leading saturation-floor bins were excluded because they lack a baseline.
sub_hypo.relations: Simultaneous opposing changes in 100-year deltas: Form drops by at least 1.0 sigma (sigma = 0.98), reaching a floor <= -1.0 sustained for at least 4 consecutive bins; Decoration rises by at least 1.0 sigma (sigma = 0.86), reaching a plateau >= +0.7 sustained for at least 3 consecutive bins. ZKeform/Zkeverz cross-checks give identical deltas at BCE 1700; using interpolated-series standard deviations as a sensitivity test gives the same detection.

sub_hypo.text: At BCE 1000, Diversity in Pottery Decoration rises further while Diversity in Pottery Form remains collapsed.
sub_hypo.context: Secondary inflection at BCE 1000 in the raw century-resolution, Z-standardized PotteryForm and PotteryDecoration series, without detrending. Interpolated columns were sanity checks only, not primary evidence.
sub_hypo.relations: Decoration steps upward from +0.97 to +1.53 while Form remains at its collapsed floor.
